security_audit.summary: Reviewed 63 static findings in SKILL.md. Most were false positives from Markdown code fences, documentation links, and example SQLite paths. Three bash examples are confirmed because they recommend unpinned `npx agentdb@latest` commands that execute external npm package code and may inspect local AgentDB files.

remediation.suggestion: Replace `npx agentdb@latest` with pinned, reviewed CLI versions and include a note to inspect commands before running them.

remediation.issue: Local database access in CLI examples
remediation.suggestion: Explain that stats commands read local `.agentdb` files and should run only on intended databases with appropriate backups.

content.value_statement: AgentDB deployments can slow down and consume too much memory as vector counts grow. This skill guides quantization, HNSW tuning, caching, batching, and monitoring for faster vector search.
actual_capabilities: Explains binary, scalar, product, and full precision quantization tradeoffs.
Provides HNSW parameter guidance for small, medium, large, and massive datasets.
Shows cache sizing and cache hit rate checks for AgentDB adapters.
Describes batch insert and parallel retrieval patterns for vector workloads.
Includes troubleshooting steps for memory usage, search latency, and accuracy loss.
limitations: Does not include executable helper scripts or automated migration tools.
Benchmark numbers depend on hardware, dataset shape, and AgentDB version.
Commands use npm package execution and should be reviewed before running.
Examples assume Node.js and AgentDB are already installed.

use_cases.title: Tune Large Vector Stores
use_cases.description: Choose quantization and HNSW settings for datasets that are growing beyond memory or latency targets.

use_cases.title: Improve Semantic Search Latency
use_cases.description: Apply cache, retrieval, and batch patterns to reduce response time in an AgentDB-backed application.

use_cases.title: Plan Edge or Mobile Deployment
use_cases.description: Compare memory tradeoffs before selecting binary, scalar, or product quantization for constrained environments.

prompt_templates.title: Review Current Settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my AgentDB configuration and explain which settings affect memory, search speed, and accuracy. Ask for missing dataset details first.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Quantization
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a quantization strategy for an AgentDB store with [vector count], [dimension], [latency target], and [accuracy requirement].

prompt_templates.title: Tune HNSW and Cache
prompt_templates.prompt: Suggest HNSW and cache settings for [dataset size] vectors. Explain the speed, recall, and memory tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Scaling Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a staged AgentDB optimization plan for growth from [current vectors] to [target vectors], including benchmarks and rollback checks.

output_examples.input: Optimize a 100K-vector AgentDB deployment with high memory use.
output_examples.output: Recommended scalar quantization first, then cache review and HNSW validation. Expected result: lower memory with small accuracy impact.

output_examples.input: Search is fast, but recall dropped after binary quantization.
output_examples.output: Suggested testing scalar quantization and increasing search quality before changing application logic. The report flagged accuracy checks as the main validation step.

output_examples.input: Prepare a benchmark plan before moving to one million vectors.
output_examples.output: Delivered a benchmark checklist covering baseline latency, memory usage, cache hit rate, index settings, and post-change accuracy review.

best_practices: Benchmark before and after each change with the same dataset and query set.
Choose quantization based on acceptable accuracy loss, not only memory reduction.
Pin and review CLI package versions before running AgentDB commands.
anti_patterns: Do not enable binary quantization without measuring recall on real queries.
Do not increase cache size without checking memory limits and hit rate.
Do not run unpinned npm commands in production automation.

faq.question: Does this skill run database commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides examples and guidance. Review any command before execution.

faq.question: Which AgentDB version does it target?
faq.answer: The skill states AgentDB v1.0.7 or later through agentic-flow.

faq.question: Can it improve search accuracy?
faq.answer: It can guide settings that protect recall, but it does not retrain embeddings.

faq.question: Is binary quantization always best?
faq.answer: No. It saves the most memory, but it can reduce accuracy more than scalar quantization.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include monitoring guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers statistics, cache hit rate, database size, and latency metrics.
